info.name: ai-parrot A2UI — AgentDashboard surfaces (FEAT-469/470/473/491/492/493)
info.description:
All routes used by the navigator-frontend-next AgentDashboard service: AgentTalk chat (A2UI envelopes), A2UIHandler RPC/SSE, persistent ui_surfaces (JSON + interactive HTML via the FEAT-493 renderer), deep links, recipes, artifacts and the legacy infographic lane.

Set collection variables: baseUrl, token (bearer), agentId (default flex_dashboard), sessionId (any uuid you own). Pin requests capture surfaceId / dashboardSurfaceId / refreshableSurfaceId / shareToken automatically.

Reference: docs/frontend/agentdashboard-a2ui-reference.md

item.name: 1. Agent chat (AgentTalk)
item.description: POST /api/v1/agents/chat/{agent_id} — the endpoint the AgentDashboard service calls. Send output_mode: "a2ui" in the BODY (the ?output_mode= query parameter is dead code). The A2UI response is always JSON: {input, output, output_mode: "a2ui", a2ui_envelope}. If no surface was produced the agent degrades to output_mode "default" with no a2ui_envelope.

request.description: FlexDashboard widget skill. Expect a2ui_envelope.createSurface with root component Chart (line, x=month).

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('a2ui envelope present', () => pm.expect(j).to.have.property('a2ui_envelope'));

request.description: Hero totals map to one KPICard each.
Expect root component Map with layers stores/employees and dataModel.layers[i].features.
LLM-authored Infographic surface. Prose caption in `output`, envelope in `a2ui_envelope`.
Requires the backend to have registered the refresh_dashboard tool (agent.build_refresh_tool(pctx)).
FEAT-473: response carries the legacy structured config in `output`/`data` plus `a2ui_envelope` and `artifacts[]` (schemaVersion 2).
KB-grounded Q&A. Standard envelope {input, output, data, response, output_mode, code, metadata, sources, tool_calls}.
Response: text/plain chunks, then the separator \n\x00, then one JSON object that includes a2ui_envelope. Header X-Parrot-Stream: chunked-aimessage.
404 with a RAW STRING body under Content-Type: application/json — guard JSON.parse.

item.name: 2. A2UI RPC (A2UIHandler)
item.description: /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/a2ui — renderer->agent envelopes. Identity (session_id, user_id, agent_name) travels in the QUERY STRING because the body is a protocol-strict envelope. One message back => bare envelope with Content-Type application/a2ui+json; several => {messages:[...]}; sole error => 400 with the error envelope.

request.description: {"v1.0": {"supportedCatalogIds": [parrot, basic], "acceptsInlineCatalogs": false}}
Persists SurfaceState (dataModel) for the session; no userMessage => a system turn tagged a2ui_action. The handler then runs the turn on the agent and may append a fresh createSurface.

item.name: POST action with userMessage (visible user turn)

request.description: userMessage becomes the user turn text verbatim.

ALWAYS send callFunction.catalogId. Success => {version, agentFunctionResponse: {functionCallId, value: {filters, filter_source, artifact_id, bytes}}}. Unregistered tool => 400 error INVALID_FUNCTION_CALL.
Every ToolManager tool is renderer-invocable unless a2ui_hidden. Set {{functionName}} to a tool name from the agent.
Unknown/expired functionCallId => 400 error NOT_FOUND.

item.name: POST error (surface validation error, two-shape rule)

request.description: Surface errors (no functionCallId) are only logged; returns 200 with no messages (empty body or {messages: []}).
Array or JSONL body. Response {messages: [...]} when more than one message results.
400 {version:'v1.0', error:{code:'INVALID_FUNCTION_CALL', message:'Malformed JSON body.', functionCallId:'unknown'}}
text/event-stream; frames `data: {version, callRendererFunction:{functionCallId, callFunction:{call,args,catalogId}}}`; `: keepalive` every 15 s. Postman will hold the connection — cancel manually.
Mirror of GET /api/v1/ui/surfaces/{id}; same negotiation and access rules; additionally resolves the agent.
Self-contained interactive HTML (FEAT-493).

item.name: 3. UI surfaces (FEAT-492 rehydration)
item.description: /api/v1/ui/surfaces — persistent, bookmarkable A2UI surfaces of kind dashboard | infographic | widget. Negotiation: ?format=html|json wins over Accept; default JSON. Errors: {status:'error', message}. Unknown/foreign => 404, bad share token => 410, HTML renderer missing => 501.

request.description: Owned first (access: owner), then claimed shares (access: shared).
`envelope` is the createSurface PAYLOAD (inner object), validated as CreateSurface. 201 {surface_id: uuid4}. Saves surface_id into {{surfaceId}}.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.surface_id) pm.collectionVariables.set('surfaceId', j.surface_id);

item.name: Pin/save: dashboard (Infographic w/ FilterBar, theme+layout hints)

request.description: Two sections => two tabs in every renderer. metadata.extensions.parrot_theme/parrot_layout select the HTML design-system axes. Saves surface_id into {{dashboardSurfaceId}}.
recipe_name makes the row refreshable (POST .../refresh re-runs the recipe with request params > stored params > defaults).
XOR with envelope; needs agent_id + session_id. 404 artifact not found, 503 no artifact store.
{status, envelope: createSurface, metadata: {surface_id, kind, title, refreshable, created_at, updated_at, catalog_id, agent_id}}
Rendered on the fly by InteractiveHTMLRenderer (FEAT-493): single self-contained document, div.ds-page[data-layout][data-theme], inlined Chart.js, FilterBar runtime.

item.name: Get surface as HTML (Accept header only)

request.description: First authenticated opener claims the token; then it shows in their list as access: shared. Revoked/expired => 410.

item.name: Refresh surface (re-run recipe, returns negotiated surface)

request.description: 409 when not refreshable; 422 RecipeRunError (502 when stage == data); 500 when recipe_runner unconfigured. Add ?format=html to get the refreshed HTML directly.
ttl:true with no expires_at => now + 90 days; default no expiry. 201 {token, expires_at, permissions:'read+refresh'}. Saves token into {{shareToken}}.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.token) pm.collectionVariables.set('shareToken', j.token);

request.description: Owner only; cascades share rows.

item.name: 4. Deep-link resume
item.description: /api/v1/a2ui/resume/web — single-use, TTL 900 s tokens minted by the backend for actions on static surfaces (PDF/SSR). Mounted only when Redis is available.

item.name: GET landing (does NOT consume the token)

request.description: 200 {status:'resumed', session_id, result} | 400 missing token | 410 expired/replayed

item.name: 5. Infographic recipes (deterministic dashboards)
item.description: /api/v1/infographic_recipes — the recipe lane behind refreshable dashboards. /run returns artifact METADATA, never HTML bytes.

request.description: {status:'success', artifact:{artifact_id, filename, mime_type:'text/html', size, storage_ref}}. Undeclared param => 422 RecipeRunError. Known bug: fails on a cold worker when render.profile is the default 'interactive-html' (see reference §11).

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.artifact && j.artifact.artifact_id) pm.collectionVariables.set('artifactId', j.artifact.artifact_id);

item.name: 6. Artifacts (rendered HTML by id)
item.description: Session-scoped artifact CRUD and the unauthenticated signed public HTML URL (the html_url on infographic responses).

request.description: Adds Content-Disposition: attachment.

Signature = {expiry}.{base64url(HMAC-SHA256(INFOGRAPHIC_SIGNING_KEY, '{artifact_id}|{expiry}'))}, default TTL 7 days. 403 plain text on bad/expired signature. CSP frame-ancestors defaults to 'self' (set INFOGRAPHIC_FRAME_ANCESTORS to iframe cross-origin).

item.name: 7. Infographic lane (pre-A2UI, still live)
item.description: /api/v1/agents/infographic — block-model infographics. Default response is HTML (opposite of ui_surfaces). Registered themes: light, dark, corporate, midnight, petrol.

request.description: RenderResponse {artifact_id, url, url_note, template, sections_validated, persisted, timings}. async:true => 202 {job_id}.
